sec02-card-sec02-F06.question_text: Who completes the Certification of Supervised Driving form, and when do you turn it in?
sec02-card-sec02-F06.teaching_text: Forgetting that signed practice certification when applying for your license stalls your upgrade at the counter.

sec02-card-sec02-F07.question_text: Which three requirements unlock an Option A probationary license?
sec02-card-sec02-F07.teaching_text: Any suspension or postponement restarts the clock—you need six clean supervised months, age seventeen, and a passed road check.

sec02-card-sec02-F08.question_text: After earning an Option A probationary license, what solo milestone and minimum age unlock the basic license?
sec02-card-sec02-F08.teaching_text: Teens drive solo under GDL limits for at least twelve full months and reach eighteen before going unrestricted.

sec02-card-sec02-F26.question_text: What happens if you finish twelve probationary months without visiting a Licensing Center to upgrade?
sec02-card-sec02-F26.teaching_text: Turning eighteen never lifts curfew, passenger, or decal rules automatically—police still enforce them until you upgrade.

sec02-card-sec02-F10.question_text: How does GDL Option B—the young adult road—begin, and who still needs parent or guardian consent?
sec02-card-sec02-F10.teaching_text: Starting at seventeen uses an examination permit after passing knowledge and vision checks, requiring parental consent only under eighteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F31.question_text: Who qualifies for an examination permit, and which two school or instructor ties are NOT required?
sec02-card-sec02-F31.teaching_text: Waiting until seventeen lets an eligible resident buy an examination permit directly without driving-school enrollment.

sec02-card-sec02-R03.question_text: How does a special learner permit differ from an examination permit regarding school and instructors?
sec02-card-sec02-R03.teaching_text: Sixteen-year-olds enter through an instructor-bought school permit, whereas seventeen-plus applicants buy examination permits directly.

sec02-card-sec02-F11.question_text: How much supervised driving must an Option B applicant complete before taking the road evaluation?
sec02-card-sec02-F11.teaching_text: Waiting until seventeen skips the driving-school requirement yet keeps the exact six-month, fifty-hour practice rule.

sec02-card-sec02-F12.question_text: What final stage and minimum age complete Option B for a basic license?
sec02-card-sec02-F12.teaching_text: After passing the road check, Option B drivers complete twelve unsupervised probationary months and reach at least eighteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F13.question_text: At what age does GDL Option C—the adult road—begin, and what comes first?
sec02-card-sec02-F13.teaching_text: First-time drivers aged twenty-one and older enter Option C with an examination permit after knowledge and vision checks.

sec02-card-sec02-F14.question_text: How long are the supervised and unsupervised phases on Option C before earning a basic license?
sec02-card-sec02-F14.teaching_text: Adults twenty-one and up cut supervised permit practice in half to three clean months, yet still serve one probationary year.

sec02-card-sec02-R07.question_text: What supervised duration appears on the Option C adult chart, and what teen requirement is left off?
sec02-card-sec02-R07.teaching_text: Unlike the fifty-hour log under twenty-one, the adult road chart requires three months without listing a practice-hour minimum.

sec02-card-sec02-F32.question_text: How long do passed knowledge and vision screening results remain valid?
sec02-card-sec02-F32.teaching_text: Waiting more than twenty-four months to finish licensing means retaking both your knowledge and vision screenings.

sec02-card-sec02-R05.question_text: Along with the special learner permit, what two MVC screening results also stay valid for two years?
sec02-card-sec02-R05.teaching_text: Permit validity, written scores, and vision checks all align cleanly on the same two-year expiration clock.

sec02-card-sec02-F15.question_text: Between which exact late-night and early-morning hours are GDL permit and probationary drivers barred from driving?
sec02-card-sec02-F15.teaching_text: Watch that exact start minute—curfew begins at 11:01 p.m., not midnight, and runs until 5:00 a.m.

sec02-card-sec02-F24.question_text: When and how may a GDL driver under twenty-one legally drive during overnight curfew hours?
sec02-card-sec02-F24.teaching_text: Verbal excuses fail at a late-night traffic stop—carry signed official letterhead from your employer or religious institution.

sec02-card-sec02-R08.question_text: Which GDL rule alone does the work-or-religion waiver lift, and what must stay in the car?
sec02-card-sec02-R08.teaching_text: Having a job note never excuses extra friends or phone use—it only covers overnight curfew while carried.

sec02-card-sec02-F16.question_text: Which cell phones and electronic devices are banned across all three GDL stages while driving?
sec02-card-sec02-F16.teaching_text: Bluetooth speakerphone will not save a GDL driver—both handheld and hands-free electronics are completely forbidden.

sec02-card-sec02-F17.question_text: What seat, minimum age, license state, and years of experience must a permit holder's supervising driver have?
sec02-card-sec02-F17.teaching_text: An out-of-state relative or a twenty-year-old friend cannot supervise—you need twenty-one-plus, NJ-licensed, three-year experience up front.

sec02-card-sec02-F25.question_text: Who takes legal responsibility if a student driver commits a traffic violation during supervised practice?
sec02-card-sec02-F25.teaching_text: Supervising adults cannot nap in the passenger seat because traffic citations hold both seats accountable.

sec02-card-sec02-F02.question_text: What fine or license consequence can hit a motorist who violates GDL restrictions?
sec02-card-sec02-F02.teaching_text: Treating passenger caps, decals, or curfews lightly risks a hundred-dollar ticket or losing your hard-earned privilege.

sec02-card-sec02-F18.question_text: Who is allowed to ride as a passenger with a special learner permit driver?
sec02-card-sec02-F18.teaching_text: Along with the supervising driver, a sixteen-year-old permit holder may carry household parents, guardians, or dependents plus one friend.

sec02-card-sec02-F19.question_text: How many passengers may an examination permit or probationary driver carry, and what lifts that cap?
sec02-card-sec02-F19.teaching_text: Driving solo on probation caps non-dependent friends at one unless your parent or guardian sits inside the vehicle.

sec02-card-sec02-R01.question_text: How does the passenger wording for a special learner permit differ from an examination permit?
sec02-card-sec02-R01.teaching_text: Special learner permits always include parents, guardians, or dependents plus one, whereas exam permits lift the cap when parents ride.

sec02-card-sec02-F20.question_text: Who must buckle up inside a GDL driver's vehicle, and what must show outside?
sec02-card-sec02-F20.teaching_text: Unlike adult cars with backseat exceptions, GDL drivers must ensure every single occupant wears a seat belt.

sec02-card-sec02-F22.question_text: On which exact corner of which plates do GDL drivers under twenty-one stick their red decals?
sec02-card-sec02-F22.teaching_text: Sticking decals on windshields, bumpers, or right corners fails—place one on each plate's upper-left corner.

sec02-card-sec02-F23.question_text: How do GDL drivers get their removable decals, and how much does a pair or extra pair cost?
sec02-card-sec02-F23.teaching_text: Families sharing two cars can pick up an extra four-dollar removable pair at any Licensing Center.

sec02-card-sec02-F21.question_text: Which three GDL restrictions drop away for examination permit or probationary drivers aged twenty-one or older?
sec02-card-sec02-F21.teaching_text: Adult learners twenty-one and up skip the overnight curfew, one-passenger cap, and red license-plate decals.

sec02-card-sec02-R02.question_text: Which three limits does the age-twenty-one footnote lift, and which two GDL rules does it NOT lift?
sec02-card-sec02-R02.teaching_text: Even at twenty-five on a probationary license, hands-free and handheld device bans and seat-belt rules remain unmentioned by the exemption.

sec02-card-sec02-F33.question_text: Does a newcomer holding a valid out-of-state driver license still need a New Jersey examination permit?
sec02-card-sec02-F33.teaching_text: Even experienced adult transfers process through a New Jersey driver examination permit step at the agency.

sec02-card-sec02-F34.question_text: How soon after becoming a permanent New Jersey resident must an out-of-state driver buy an examination permit?
sec02-card-sec02-F34.teaching_text: Mark sixty days from establishing residency—or sooner if your former state credential expires first.

sec02-card-sec02-F35.question_text: What happens when an out-of-state licensed driver younger than eighteen moves to New Jersey?
sec02-card-sec02-F35.teaching_text: Holding an unrestricted teen license from another state does not bypass New Jersey's graduated licensing rules under eighteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F36.question_text: Which screening must out-of-state transfers always pass, and what waives their knowledge and road checks?
sec02-card-sec02-F36.teaching_text: Showing a valid non-probationary license or certified abstract from a U.S. state, D.C., or territory skips written and road checks.

sec02-card-sec02-F37.question_text: What extra document should foreign-licensed visitors carry, and where must non-citizens obtain an IDP?
sec02-card-sec02-F37.teaching_text: Non-citizens cannot buy an International Driving Permit after landing—it must be issued in their home country before travel.

sec02-card-sec02-F38.question_text: What helpful role does an International Driving Permit serve, and what can it never replace?
sec02-card-sec02-F38.teaching_text: Handing an officer only an IDP booklet without your valid home-country driver license does not authorize driving.

sec02-card-sec02-R09.question_text: Why must a visiting foreign driver carry their valid home license alongside an International Driving Permit?
sec02-card-sec02-R09.teaching_text: Because the IDP only translates and identifies, driving authority still rests entirely on the underlying valid license.

sec02-card-sec02-F39.question_text: Who can apply for a New Jersey non-driver ID card, and when must that card be surrendered?
sec02-card-sec02-F39.teaching_text: Unlicensed residents can carry a state ID starting at fourteen, then turn it in once issued a driver license.

sec02-card-sec02-F40.question_text: How do you have the words organ donor printed onto your New Jersey license?
sec02-card-sec02-F40.teaching_text: Confirming organ donation during your MVC transaction prints your life-saving choice right on your card.

sec02-card-sec02-R10.question_text: At which two milestone ages and transactions does the MVC ask about the Donate Life Registry?
sec02-card-sec02-R10.teaching_text: Non-driver ID applicants hear the question at fourteen, and unrestricted license or renewal applicants hear it at eighteen.

sec02-card-sec02-R11.question_text: What is the minimum donor registration age, what does donation cost the family, and how are funerals affected?
sec02-card-sec02-R11.teaching_text: Donors aged fourteen and up match through a national list at zero expense to families and without disrupting funeral plans.

sec02-card-sec02-F41.question_text: Who can use New Jersey's Next-of-Kin Registry under Sara's Law, and when may police access those contacts?
sec02-card-sec02-F41.teaching_text: Emergency numbers stay private for police use strictly when a crash leaves a cardholder unable to communicate.

sec02-card-sec02-R12.question_text: Which MVC cardholders qualify for the Next-of-Kin Registry, and what two ways can contacts be submitted?
sec02-card-sec02-R12.teaching_text: Holders of licenses, permits, non-driver IDs, and even boat licenses can file emergency contacts online or by mail.

sec02-card-sec02-F42.question_text: Under the National Voter Registration Act, during which three MVC transactions must staff offer voter registration?
sec02-card-sec02-F42.teaching_text: Federal motor-voter rules connect license applications, renewals, and address updates directly to voter sign-ups.

sec02-card-sec02-R13.question_text: What decibel threshold, card mark, and medical sign-off apply to a hearing-impaired driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-R13.teaching_text: A numeric code verified by a physician or audiologist alerts officers during stops when hearing loss reaches forty-one decibels.

sec02-card-sec02-R14.question_text: What are the three commercial license classes, and what license must you already hold to apply?
sec02-card-sec02-R14.teaching_text: Every commercial applicant starts from either a valid New Jersey Class D license or an existing out-of-state CDL.

sec02-card-sec02-R15.question_text: Which combined and towed weight ratings demand a Class A CDL, and which lower classes can it cover?
sec02-card-sec02-R15.teaching_text: Heavy combinations at 26,001 pounds or more pulling trailers over 10,000 pounds need Class A, which also covers B, C, and D.

sec02-card-sec02-R16.question_text: Which vehicle weights, trailer limits, and passenger counts fall under a Class B CDL?
sec02-card-sec02-R16.teaching_text: Class B covers single vehicles at 26,001 pounds or more—including heavy sixteen-plus buses—towing 10,000 pounds or less.

sec02-card-sec02-R17.question_text: Which three hazmat or passenger categories under 26,001 pounds require a Class C CDL?
sec02-card-sec02-R17.teaching_text: Lighter rigs still need Class C when placarded for hazmat, built for sixteen-plus riders, or carrying eight to fifteen for hire.

sec02-card-sec02-R18.question_text: Which five groups—including taxis, emergency rigs, farms within 150 miles, funerals, and RVs—do NOT need a CDL?
sec02-card-sec02-R18.teaching_text: Personal recreational vehicles, local farm hauls within 150 miles, fire trucks, funeral cars, and taxis stay exempt from CDL rules.

sec02-card-sec02-R19.question_text: What three requirements earn the P passenger endorsement, and which two letters must school-bus drivers hold?
sec02-card-sec02-R19.teaching_text: Carrying passengers demands age twenty-one, three years' experience, and a road check—and school buses require both S and P.

sec02-card-sec02-R20.question_text: How do the requirements for the H hazmat endorsement compare with the N tanker endorsement?
sec02-card-sec02-R20.teaching_text: Both take a knowledge check, while H adds age twenty-one plus training and retesting every two years.

sec02-card-sec02-R21.question_text: What does Restriction L bar on a commercial license, and which manual prepares all CDL screenings?
sec02-card-sec02-R21.teaching_text: Skipping the air-brake portion puts Restriction L on your CDL, and every commercial screening draws from the Commercial Driver Manual.

sec04-card-sec04-F01.question_text: Under New Jersey law, which occupants of a car, van, pickup, or SUV must buckle a seat belt?
sec04-card-sec04-F01.teaching_text: Every seat row inside passenger vehicles falls under New Jersey's mandatory belt requirement.

sec04-card-sec04-F02.question_text: Which three unbelted occupants give New Jersey police primary authority to pull a vehicle over for that violation alone?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.teaching_text: Officers need zero speeding or equipment pretexts to initiate a stop when front occupants or minors ride unbuckled.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.question_text: Under what condition can an unbuckled back-seat passenger aged eighteen or older receive a summons?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.teaching_text: Rear-seat adults still owe a seat-belt ticket once any primary traffic infraction pulls the car to the curb.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.question_text: What separates New Jersey's primary seat-belt enforcement from its secondary rule for adult rear-seat riders?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.teaching_text: Exam questions test whether officers can pull you over directly versus citing adult back-seat riders only after another stop.

sec04-card-sec04-F03.question_text: For standard license holders, who answers legally for unbuckled minors under eighteen versus unbuckled front-seat adults?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.teaching_text: Adults riding up front sign for their own belt summons, whereas every minor's belt violation lands on the driver.

sec04-card-sec04-F05.question_text: What expanded seat-belt responsibility rests on a driver holding a GDL permit or probationary license?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.teaching_text: Graduated licensing strips away the adult self-responsibility carve-out—every unbuckled rider in any row falls on the GDL driver.

sec04-card-sec04-R02.question_text: How does passenger belt accountability shift when you move from a GDL license to an unrestricted basic license?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.teaching_text: On a probationary license even a twenty-five-year-old friend unbuckled in back makes you legally responsible.

sec04-card-sec04-F06.question_text: Which vintage vehicles, federal categories, or medical cases are exempt from New Jersey's seat-belt mandate?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.teaching_text: Cars built before July one, nineteen sixty-six, federally belt-exempt rigs, and written physician waivers form the sole exceptions.

sec04-card-sec04-R03.question_text: What duty applies to a driver transporting a passenger seated in a wheelchair?
sec04-card-sec04-R03.teaching_text: Locking both the mobility frame and the rider's restraint prevents catastrophic cabin movement under hard braking.

sec04-card-sec04-F07.question_text: By what percentage does wearing a seat belt raise a motorist's odds of surviving a crash?
sec04-card-sec04-F07.teaching_text: Few safety choices match lifting survival odds by sixty percent before the wheels ever roll.

sec04-card-sec04-R04.question_text: How many times better are crash survival odds when wearing both a lap belt and a shoulder strap?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.teaching_text: Pairing upper-torso restraint with hip anchoring multiplies crash survival three to four times over riding unrestrained.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.question_text: Slamming unrestrained into the dashboard or windshield at thirty miles per hour equals falling from what height?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.teaching_text: Town speeds feel gentle until abrupt deceleration slams an unbuckled body forward with three-story free-fall violence.

sec04-card-sec04-R05.question_text: Roughly how many seconds does clicking on a seat belt actually take?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.teaching_text: Trading three seconds in the driveway beats gambling against life-altering ejection injuries on short neighborhood errands.

sec04-card-sec04-R06.question_text: Which two physical actions allow seat belts to reduce crash injury severity?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.teaching_text: Riding down crumple-zone deceleration inside the steel safety cage beats flying through glass onto pavement.

sec04-card-sec04-F09.question_text: Where across your torso and pelvis should the lap belt and shoulder strap rest?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.teaching_text: Anchoring across strong pelvic bones and collarbone—never soft stomach organs or your throat—prevents internal belt injuries.

sec04-card-sec04-R07.question_text: May two passengers ever buckle a single seat belt around both bodies together?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.teaching_text: Strapping two bodies inside one loop crushes them violently together under crash forces.

sec04-card-sec04-F10.question_text: Why must everyone—including back-seat passengers—wear lap and shoulder belts even inside air-bag-equipped cars?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.teaching_text: Air bags deploy briefly for front hits and cannot stop rollovers, side impacts, or unbuckled rear-seat throws.

sec04-card-sec04-F11.question_text: Since January one, nineteen eighty-one, what testing and label details must every child restraint carry?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.teaching_text: Checking that compliance sticker verifies federal crash certification and reveals whether an older hand-me-down seat expired.

sec04-card-sec04-F12.question_text: Which direction must an infant carrier never face, and where do you check its size and weight limits?
sec04-card-sec04-F12.teaching_text: Cradling fragile infant necks against rear-facing shells spreads crash loads safely within printed weight and height bounds.

sec04-card-sec04-F16.question_text: Beyond buying an approved car seat, what habit gives a child the strongest protection?
sec04-card-sec04-F16.teaching_text: Even top-rated seats fail when straps hang loose or parents skip buckling for quick local errands.

sec04-card-sec04-F15.question_text: How must children under age two and weighing under thirty pounds ride under New Jersey's manual?
sec04-card-sec04-F15.teaching_text: Rear-facing five-point shells support a toddler's heavy head and developing spine during frontal braking.

sec04-card-sec04-F14.question_text: Where and in what restraint must children under age four weighing under forty pounds ride?
sec04-card-sec04-F14.teaching_text: Keeping preschoolers rear-facing to the seat's top limit before turning forward-facing in back maximizes five-point protection.

sec04-card-sec04-F13.question_text: What restraint and seating rules apply to children under age eight who stand shorter than fifty-seven inches?
sec04-card-sec04-F13.teaching_text: Until kids reach age eight or four feet nine inches, adult belts ride dangerously high without a harness or booster.

sec04-card-sec04-R08.question_text: Can you line up New Jersey's three progressive child-restraint cutoffs—two, four, and eight?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.teaching_text: Pair two with thirty pounds rear-facing, four with forty pounds harnessed, and eight with fifty-seven inches boosted.
sec04-card-sec04-R08.must_match_memory_hook: Two rear-facing, four harness, eight booster

visual_sync.text_span: Two rear-facing, four harness, eight booster

sec04-card-sec04-F17.question_text: When is a child under age eight legally permitted to ride in a front passenger seat?
sec04-card-sec04-F17.teaching_text: Two-seat pickups or sports cars allow front-row child restraints only because no rear row exists.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.question_text: Which children are barred from riding aboard a three-wheeled autocycle in New Jersey?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.teaching_text: Enclosed three-wheel autocycles cannot safely anchor child seats or boosters covered by the child-restraint statute.

sec04-card-sec04-F19.question_text: What fine range—before fees and court costs—applies for breaking New Jersey's child passenger safety law?
sec04-card-sec04-F19.teaching_text: Mandatory court fees stack onto that fifty-to-seventy-five-dollar base fine for improper child restraints.

sec04-card-sec04-F20.question_text: What crash role are air bags designed for, and which new vehicles must carry them under federal rules?
sec04-card-sec04-F20.teaching_text: Every new passenger car and light truck pairs frontal air bags with belts as a coordinated system.

sec04-card-sec04-F21.question_text: Up to how fast do air bags burst open, and when should a belted adult contact the cushion?
sec04-card-sec04-F21.teaching_text: Seat belts hold your chest back just long enough for the explosive two-hundred-mile-per-hour blast to finish opening.

sec04-card-sec04-F22.question_text: Why do air bags pose opposite outcomes for belted adults compared with children sitting up front?
sec04-card-sec04-F22.teaching_text: Bags aimed at adult chests strike smaller front-seat children squarely at head and neck height.

sec04-card-sec04-F18.question_text: Where must a rear-facing infant or toddler restraint never be installed?
sec04-card-sec04-F18.teaching_text: A rear-facing shell sits inches from the dash cover, where an active bag slams the child violently backward.

sec04-card-sec04-F23.question_text: Up through what age does the manual recommend keeping all children in the back seat?
sec04-card-sec04-F23.teaching_text: Even after outgrowing boosters at eight, preteens twelve and under stay far safer away from front air bags.

sec04-card-sec04-R13.question_text: In a vehicle equipped with front air bags, where and facing which way should an infant always ride?
sec04-card-sec04-R13.teaching_text: Combining rear-facing shell support with back-row spacing eliminates passenger-air-bag impact risk completely.

sec04-card-sec04-F24.question_text: Which words or three-letter abbreviations stamped on the wheel and dash identify air bags?
sec04-card-sec04-F24.teaching_text: Supplemental Restraint System and Supplemental Inflatable Restraint markings confirm front bags sit behind trim panels.

sec04-card-sec04-R14.question_text: Besides the wheel hub and dashboard, what three places commonly display air-bag warning labels?
sec04-card-sec04-R14.teaching_text: Bright yellow visor stickers and door-frame decals remind drivers never to place rear-facing seats up front.

sec04-card-sec04-R10.question_text: How did federal NHTSA air-bag cutoff switch rules expand between nineteen ninety-five and January nineteen ninety-eight?
sec04-card-sec04-R10.teaching_text: Factory cutoffs started in pickups and two-seaters in ninety-five before dealer retrofits opened by application in ninety-eight.

sec04-card-sec04-R11.question_text: Which narrow group qualifies for cutoff switches on both the driver and passenger air bags?
sec04-card-sec04-R11.teaching_text: Only rare medical conditions where bag inflation poses higher danger than hitting the dash justify shutting off both.

sec04-card-sec04-R12.question_text: What ten-inch rule qualifies for a driver cutoff switch, and what child situations qualify for a passenger switch?
sec04-card-sec04-R12.teaching_text: Drivers unable to sit ten inches back qualify on the left, while missing rear space or medical monitoring qualifies right.

sec04-card-sec04-F25.question_text: When should white backup lights illuminate, and what does New Jersey forbid while driving forward?
sec04-card-sec04-F25.teaching_text: Shining white reverse lamps while cruising forward confuses trailing drivers into thinking you are backing toward them.

sec04-card-sec04-R17.question_text: How can you verify brake bulbs work, and why must cracked plastic taillight covers be replaced?
sec04-card-sec04-R17.teaching_text: Exposed clear bulbs behind shattered red lenses throw harsh white glare straight into following drivers' eyes.

sec04-card-sec04-R18.question_text: If oncoming drivers repeatedly flash at you while your switch is already on low beam, what is likely wrong?
sec04-card-sec04-R18.teaching_text: Misaligned low beams tilt upward into opposing windshields and need mechanical re-aiming.

sec04-card-sec04-F26.question_text: Which three steering, pedal, or sound clues tell you your brakes need immediate inspection?
sec04-card-sec04-F26.teaching_text: Uneven caliper grab yanks steering sideways while metal-on-metal squealing or grinding signals worn-out pads.

sec04-card-sec04-F27.question_text: After driving through deep puddles with conventional drum or disc brakes, how do you dry them safely?
sec04-card-sec04-F27.teaching_text: Lightly tapping the pedal warms wet linings evenly, whereas stabbing hard on soaked drums grabs unevenly and locks.

sec04-card-sec04-F29.question_text: What pedal pressure tests anti-lock brakes properly, and what two mistakes must you avoid while braking?
sec04-card-sec04-F29.teaching_text: Pumping cancels electronic anti-lock cycling, and violently yanking the wheel mid-stop spins even ABS cars.

sec04-card-sec04-R15.question_text: How does drying conventional brakes after puddles contrast with braking in an ABS vehicle?
sec04-card-sec04-R15.teaching_text: Permit questions love testing whether you remember gentle pumping for wet non-ABS versus steady pressure for ABS.

sec04-card-sec04-R16.question_text: On which loose road surfaces can anti-lock brakes actually lengthen your stopping distance?
sec04-card-sec04-R16.teaching_text: Locked tires plow a wedge of gravel or fresh powder ahead of the tread, whereas rolling ABS wheels skim longer.

sec04-card-sec04-F28.question_text: Within how many feet should a healthy car stop from twenty miles per hour during a chalk-mark lot test?
sec04-card-sec04-F28.teaching_text: Testing on dry empty asphalt with chalk lines confirms your brakes meet New Jersey's twenty-five-foot benchmark.

sec04-card-sec04-F30.question_text: In which three situations does New Jersey advise tapping your horn without overusing it?
sec04-card-sec04-F30.teaching_text: Brief alerts when overtaking or emerging from blind alleys, curves, or driveways prevent surprises without road-rage noise.

sec04-card-sec04-R19.question_text: How should a mechanically sound vehicle track and feel on a straight, level road?
sec04-card-sec04-R19.teaching_text: Front-end vibration or sloppy dead-zone play in the wheel warns of worn tie-rods, alignment drift, or unbalanced tires.

sec04-card-sec04-R20.question_text: What two steps apply right away if your electric turn signals burn out or fail?
sec04-card-sec04-R20.teaching_text: Arm cues keep turns legal and predictable on the way to getting burned-out bulbs or relays fixed.

sec04-card-sec04-F31.question_text: When should you gauge tire pressure, and where do you look up the exact target number?
sec04-card-sec04-F31.teaching_text: Sidewall numbers list maximum safe pressure rather than your car's tuned door-jamb and manual rating.

sec04-card-sec04-F32.question_text: What minimum tread depth—tested with a penny—and tire-mixing ban apply in New Jersey?
sec04-card-sec04-F32.teaching_text: Bald rubber under one-sixteenth inch hydroplanes easily, and mixing radials with bias-ply tires upsets cornering balance.

sec04-card-sec04-F33.question_text: On which vehicle glass does New Jersey forbid aftermarket add-on window tinting?
sec04-card-sec04-F33.teaching_text: Keeping front glass clear preserves night visibility and eye contact with pedestrians and police officers.

sec04-card-sec04-F34.question_text: Which exterior vehicle surfaces must a New Jersey driver clear of built-up snow and ice before pulling out?
sec04-card-sec04-F34.teaching_text: Frozen roof sheets peel off at highway speed and smash through trailing windshields like airborne slabs.

sec04-card-sec04-F35.question_text: Compare New Jersey's baseline fine for uncleared snow or ice with the penalty when flying ice causes damage or injury?
sec04-card-sec04-F35.teaching_text: Skipping five minutes with a snow brush risks seventy-five dollars immediately and fifteen hundred if ice shatters glass.

sec04-card-sec04-R21.question_text: Does snow or ice actually have to blow off your roof before police can ticket you?
sec04-card-sec04-R21.teaching_text: Driving onto public roads with accumulated snow on the roof violates the statute before a single flake flies.

sec04-card-sec04-F36.question_text: Why is carbon monoxide in vehicle exhaust impossible to detect with your senses?
sec04-card-sec04-F36.teaching_text: Because pure carbon monoxide has zero smell or tint, lethal concentrations accumulate inside or beside cars unnoticed.

sec04-card-sec04-R22.question_text: Which engine issues or rear cargo-door habits pull carbon monoxide into a moving cabin?
sec04-card-sec04-R22.teaching_text: Driving with an open trunk lid or SUV hatch creates low-pressure suction that draws tailpipe fumes forward inside.

sec04-card-sec04-R23.question_text: How can snowbanks, rusted body panels, or an open garage door still cause carbon monoxide poisoning?
sec04-card-sec04-R23.teaching_text: Snow-packed tailpipes force gas up through floor rust, and idling inside a garage traps fumes even with the door up.

sec04-card-sec04-F37.question_text: Why can't drivers rely on headache, dizziness, nausea, or chest pain to warn them of carbon monoxide in time?
sec04-card-sec04-F37.teaching_text: Confusion and unconsciousness can overtake an occupant before mild dizziness ever registers as exhaust poisoning.

sec04-card-sec04-F38.question_text: What immediate steps must you take if you suspect carbon monoxide poisoning inside a vehicle?
sec04-card-sec04-F38.teaching_text: Getting everyone into fresh outside air immediately and dialing emergency responders stops ongoing gas inhalation.

sec04-card-sec04-F39.question_text: Where should you check before opening the driver's door, and what hidden hazards are you looking for?
sec04-card-sec04-F39.teaching_text: Low bumper blind zones hide toddlers, pets, and toys completely once you sit down behind the wheel.

sec04-card-sec04-F40.question_text: How far from the wheel should most drivers sit, and what five cockpit items get set before moving?
sec04-card-sec04-F40.teaching_text: Adjusting seat reach, mirrors, belts, park-and-brake hold, and door locks while parked keeps full focus once rolling.

sec04-card-sec04-F41.question_text: More than what share of all driving information reaches a motorist through the eyes?
sec04-card-sec04-F41.teaching_text: Because nearly every hazard cue arrives visually, neglected eyesight or dirty glass compromises almost everything.

sec04-card-sec04-F42.question_text: How often does the New Jersey manual recommend getting your vision examined?
sec04-card-sec04-F42.teaching_text: Gradual distance blur or shrinking peripheral vision sneaks up unnoticed without biennial optometrist checks.

sec04-card-sec04-R24.question_text: To cut nighttime headlight glare, which eyeglass lenses should you avoid and which coating should you pick?
sec04-card-sec04-R24.teaching_text: Colored lenses dim dark roads and distort signal colors, whereas clear anti-reflective coatings cut internal halo scatter.

sec04-card-sec04-R25.question_text: How does light intake at age sixty compare with age twenty in the manual's vision example?
sec04-card-sec04-R25.teaching_text: Narrowing pupils and aging lenses mean older motorists need three times as much illumination alongside fading side vision.

sec04-card-sec04-F43.question_text: Which exact piece of your car should sit in the lower-right corner of a properly aimed driver-side mirror?
sec04-card-sec04-F43.teaching_text: Putting just the front handle tip in the lower-right corner swings the glass outward into the adjacent lane.

sec04-card-sec04-R26.question_text: How does a car overtaking you on the left confirm your inside and outside mirrors overlap properly?
sec04-card-sec04-R26.teaching_text: Seamless handoff from rearview glass into side glass shrinks the blind zone where passing cars vanish.

sec04-card-sec04-F44.question_text: Right after starting the engine, how should you verify a clear path instead of trusting mirrors alone?
sec04-card-sec04-F44.teaching_text: Physically turning to look spots walkers, cyclists, and mopeds tucked inside mirror blind zones.

sec04-card-sec04-F45.question_text: What maximum idling time does New Jersey enforce for motor vehicles?
sec04-card-sec04-F45.teaching_text: Shutting off parked engines past three minutes cuts curbside exhaust fumes and wasted fuel statewide.

sec04-card-sec04-R27.question_text: Does New Jersey's three-minute idling cap apply when stuck in highway traffic or a drive-thru line?
sec04-card-sec04-R27.teaching_text: Active queues like congested lanes and restaurant drive-thru windows sit among New Jersey's statutory idling exemptions.

sec04-card-sec04-F46.question_text: What dollar fine range can hit both vehicle owners and property owners for each unlawful idling violation?
sec04-card-sec04-F46.teaching_text: Commercial lot owners and motorists alike face steep penalties starting at two hundred fifty dollars per citation.

sec12-card-sec12-F02.question_text: How many points collected within what timeframe cause the MVC to mail you a Notice of Scheduled Suspension?
sec12-card-sec12-F02.teaching_text: Watch both the point bracket and the twenty-four-month rolling window because exam distractors swap in three-year surcharge spans.
sec12-card-sec12-F02.must_match_memory_hook: Twelve to fourteen in two years

visual_sync.text_span: Twelve to fourteen in two years

sec12-card-sec12-F03.question_text: Once a Notice of Scheduled Suspension arrives, what three options do you have?
sec12-card-sec12-F03.teaching_text: Ignoring that MVC letter never pauses the clock, so every driver has to pick one of those three paths promptly.

sec12-card-sec12-R06.question_text: If you are granted a suspension hearing, which two officials have authority to decide whether your privileges get suspended?
sec12-card-sec12-R06.teaching_text: Test questions often plant local municipal police in the choices, whereas state administrative hearings rest with MVC leadership or administrative judges.

sec12-card-sec12-F04.question_text: How many points are removed from your driving record when you finish a Driver Improvement Program?
sec12-card-sec12-F04.teaching_text: Do not confuse this three-point credit with the two-point credit from a voluntary defensive driving course.

sec12-card-sec12-R07.question_text: Which two types of organizations teach New Jersey Driver Improvement and Probationary Driver classes?
sec12-card-sec12-R07.teaching_text: Taking an unapproved class will not satisfy your MVC notice, so only statewide safety groups or program-approved driving schools count.

sec12-card-sec12-F05.question_text: When taking a private-provider Driver Improvement or Probationary class, how much is the MVC admin fee and when is each fee due?
sec12-card-sec12-F05.teaching_text: Missing either payment deadline blocks your seat, leaving your scheduled suspension active while the response window runs out.
sec12-card-sec12-F05.must_match_memory_hook: Seventy-five before scheduling, provider before class

visual_sync.text_span: Seventy-five before scheduling, provider before class

sec12-card-sec12-F06.question_text: How long is your probationary period after finishing Driver Improvement or getting privileges restored, and what happens if you get a moving violation?
sec12-card-sec12-F06.teaching_text: Even a minor two-point ticket during those twelve months triggers another scheduled suspension right away.

sec12-card-sec12-F07.question_text: When does New Jersey's two-year probationary driver period officially start?
sec12-card-sec12-F07.teaching_text: Many applicants guess road test day, yet the MVC starts counting those twenty-four months the moment your permit is issued.

sec12-card-sec12-F08.question_text: During the new-driver probationary period, what ticket and point combination requires you to enroll in the Probationary Driver Program?
sec12-card-sec12-F08.teaching_text: A single four-point ticket does not trigger mandatory enrollment on its own because the rule checks both violation count and points.

sec12-card-sec12-F09.question_text: How many points can finishing the Probationary Driver Program cut, and what triggers suspension if you fail to comply or reoffend?
sec12-card-sec12-F09.teaching_text: Blowing off that mandatory class or catching even one fresh point ticket during the probationary test window suspends your license.
sec12-card-sec12-F09.must_match_memory_hook: Up to three off, otherwise suspended

visual_sync.text_span: Up to three off, otherwise suspended

sec12-card-sec12-R01.question_text: How does the point deduction for finishing a Driver Improvement Program compare with finishing a Probationary Driver Program?
sec12-card-sec12-R01.teaching_text: Exam wording hinges on that tiny phrase up to, since a probationary driver might hold fewer than three removable points.
sec12-card-sec12-R01.must_match_memory_hook: Improvement cuts three, Probationary up to

visual_sync.text_span: Improvement cuts three, Probationary up to

sec12-card-sec12-R02.question_text: How does the probation length after Driver Improvement or restoration compare with the new-driver probationary period starting at permit?
sec12-card-sec12-R02.teaching_text: Mixing up those two clocks is a favorite test trap whenever questions contrast restored drivers against brand-new permit holders.
sec12-card-sec12-R02.must_match_memory_hook: One year after, two from permit

visual_sync.text_span: One year after, two from permit

sec12-card-sec12-F10.question_text: What two benefits can you earn by completing a voluntary defensive driving course?
sec12-card-sec12-F10.teaching_text: Sharpening hazard-scanning habits voluntarily trims both your active MVC point balance and what you pay your insurer.

sec12-card-sec12-F11.question_text: How often will the MVC count a voluntary defensive driving course toward reducing points on your record?
sec12-card-sec12-F11.teaching_text: Drivers cannot stack defensive classes back-to-back to erase fresh tickets because MVC locks the point deduction for five years.
sec12-card-sec12-F11.must_match_memory_hook: Point credit once every five years

visual_sync.text_span: Point credit once every five years

sec12-card-sec12-R08.question_text: In addition to in-person classroom sessions, what other defensive driving option does the MVC list?
sec12-card-sec12-R08.teaching_text: Checking the official MVC provider list first guarantees your online completion certificate actually counts for credit.

sec12-card-sec12-F12.question_text: At what age do mature drivers qualify to take defensive driving courses through various driving schools or specific organizations?
sec12-card-sec12-F12.teaching_text: Test makers frequently slip sixty or sixty-five into the choices, so anchor fifty-five as the mature-driver threshold.

sec12-card-sec12-R09.question_text: How long is the open-enrollment driver safety class available in person or online, and what rewards can it earn?
sec12-card-sec12-R09.teaching_text: Any licensed driver can use those six hours of training to qualify for multi-year premium savings and eligible point relief.
sec12-card-sec12-R09.must_match_memory_hook: Six-hour class, discount and two points

visual_sync.text_span: Six-hour class, discount and two points

sec12-card-sec12-F21.question_text: How many points come off your total for each violation-free, suspension-free year in good standing, and how low can your total go?
sec12-card-sec12-F21.teaching_text: You cannot bank negative credit for future tickets, and privileges must stay in good standing all year to earn the cut.
sec12-card-sec12-F21.must_match_memory_hook: Up to three off, floor zero

visual_sync.text_span: Up to three off, floor zero

sec12-card-sec12-F13.question_text: At what three-year point total do surcharges kick in, and what is the base dollar charge plus per-point add-on?
sec12-card-sec12-F13.teaching_text: Crossing the six-point mark turns traffic tickets into expensive multi-year state bills on top of court fines.

sec12-card-sec12-F14.question_text: Which date determines when points count toward MVC surcharges rather than the day the violation occurred?
sec12-card-sec12-F14.teaching_text: Delaying a court appearance shifts when the conviction posts to your record, which changes which three-year surcharge window applies.
sec12-card-sec12-F14.must_match_memory_hook: Posted date counts, not violation date

visual_sync.text_span: Posted date counts, not violation date

sec12-card-sec12-R03.question_text: Once you hit six or more points within three years, for how long do point surcharges continue to apply?
sec12-card-sec12-R03.teaching_text: Fresh violations can keep extending that rolling three-year total above six points and prolong annual surcharge billing.
sec12-card-sec12-R03.must_match_memory_hook: Billed while six three-year points remain

visual_sync.text_span: Billed while six three-year points remain

sec12-card-sec12-F15.question_text: Do standard point reductions lower your surcharge total, and how often and how long is a surcharge paid?
sec12-card-sec12-F15.teaching_text: Taking a defensive or improvement class trims license suspension points, yet the surcharge billing system ignores those deductions completely.
sec12-card-sec12-F15.must_match_memory_hook: No reductions, paid yearly three years

visual_sync.text_span: No reductions, paid yearly three years

sec12-card-sec12-R11.question_text: Beyond court fines and state surcharges, what ongoing private cost can motor vehicle convictions increase?
sec12-card-sec12-R11.teaching_text: Insurers price crash risk from your driving abstract, so a single moving violation can hike monthly bills for years.

sec12-card-sec12-F16.question_text: What is the yearly surcharge for driving unlicensed compared with driving while suspended or without liability insurance?
sec12-card-sec12-F16.teaching_text: Multiply those annual figures by three years and driving uninsured or suspended quickly snowballs into seven hundred fifty dollars.

sec12-card-sec12-F17.question_text: What is the yearly surcharge for a DUI or breath-test refusal, and what does it jump to on a third offense within three years?
sec12-card-sec12-F17.teaching_text: Refusing the chemical test triggers the exact same thousand-dollar annual surcharge bill as a DUI conviction.
sec12-card-sec12-F17.must_match_memory_hook: One thousand yearly, fifteen hundred third

visual_sync.text_span: One thousand yearly, fifteen hundred third

sec12-card-sec12-F01.question_text: What three consequences hit a parent or guardian convicted of DUI while carrying a passenger under eighteen?
sec12-card-sec12-F01.teaching_text: Putting a minor in danger adds criminal disorderly-persons exposure and community service on top of standard impaired-driving penalties.
sec12-card-sec12-F01.must_match_memory_hook: Disorderly offense, six months, five days

visual_sync.text_span: Disorderly offense, six months, five days

sec12-card-sec12-F18.question_text: If you fail to pay MVC surcharges, what three legal collection actions can follow?
sec12-card-sec12-F18.teaching_text: Unpaid state surcharges do not quietly expire; collection remedies can attach your paycheck and real estate through Superior Court.
sec12-card-sec12-F18.must_match_memory_hook: Court judgment, property lien, garnished wages

visual_sync.text_span: Court judgment, property lien, garnished wages

sec12-card-sec12-F19.question_text: How long do point violations recorded after March first, nineteen seventy-four remain on a New Jersey driver's record?
sec12-card-sec12-F19.teaching_text: Annual clean-driving credits reduce your active point count, yet the underlying conviction entries never disappear from your abstract.

sec12-card-sec12-R10.question_text: Besides public highways and roadways, on what three types of government-owned and maintained spaces do traffic laws apply?
sec12-card-sec12-R10.teaching_text: Rolling a stop sign or speeding in a municipal lot carries real enforcement authority just like a public street.
sec12-card-sec12-R10.must_match_memory_hook: Government parking lots, driveways, and grounds

visual_sync.text_span: Government parking lots, driveways, and grounds

sec12-card-sec12-F25.question_text: How many points are assessed across New Jersey's three speeding brackets over the posted limit?
sec12-card-sec12-F25.teaching_text: Memorize fourteen and twenty-nine as the bracket ceilings so you never miss where two points jump to four or five.
sec12-card-sec12-F25.must_match_memory_hook: Speeding costs two, four, or five

visual_sync.text_span: Speeding costs two, four, or five

sec12-card-sec12-R05.question_text: How does the point penalty change when speeding climbs from fifteen-to-twenty-nine over the limit to thirty or more over?
sec12-card-sec12-R05.teaching_text: Hitting thirty over pushes you into the highest five-point speeding tier alongside reckless driving and tailgating.
sec12-card-sec12-R05.must_match_memory_hook: Four points jumps up to five

visual_sync.text_span: Four points jumps up to five

sec12-card-sec12-F22.question_text: What point penalties apply to racing on a highway versus not yielding to someone in a crosswalk?
sec12-card-sec12-F22.teaching_text: Street racing hits hard at five points, while ignoring a pedestrian in a crosswalk still stacks two points plus heavy court penalties.
sec12-card-sec12-F22.must_match_memory_hook: Highway racing five, crosswalk yield two

visual_sync.text_span: Highway racing five, crosswalk yield two

sec12-card-sec12-R13.question_text: What point penalty applies if a construction vehicle exceeds forty-five miles per hour?
sec12-card-sec12-R13.teaching_text: Heavy work rigs need far longer stopping distances, so New Jersey assigns a specific three-point penalty past forty-five.
sec12-card-sec12-R13.must_match_memory_hook: Construction vehicle over forty-five costs three

visual_sync.text_span: Construction vehicle over forty-five costs three

sec12-card-sec12-F24.question_text: How many points do tailgating and reckless driving each carry compared with careless driving?
sec12-card-sec12-F24.teaching_text: Test questions love pairing reckless against careless, so separate intentional five-point disregard from two-point inattentive mistakes.
sec12-card-sec12-F24.must_match_memory_hook: Tailgating and reckless five, careless two

visual_sync.text_span: Tailgating and reckless five, careless two

sec12-card-sec12-R16.question_text: How many points does driving in an unsafe manner carry, and which offense triggers those points?
sec12-card-sec12-R16.teaching_text: Drivers treat unsafe-manner pleas as zero-point shortcuts until a third violation within five years drops four points at once.
sec12-card-sec12-R16.must_match_memory_hook: Four points on third within five

visual_sync.text_span: Four points on third within five

sec12-card-sec12-F23.question_text: How many points do failing to keep right of oncoming traffic and improper passing on the right or off the roadway carry?
sec12-card-sec12-F23.teaching_text: Drifting into oncoming lanes risks head-on collisions at five points, while shoulder or illegal right-side passing costs four.
sec12-card-sec12-F23.must_match_memory_hook: Oncoming right five, bad pass four

visual_sync.text_span: Oncoming right five, bad pass four

sec12-card-sec12-F26.question_text: How many points are added to your record for improper passing in a no-passing zone?
sec12-card-sec12-F26.teaching_text: Solid barrier lines mark blind hills and curves where hidden oncoming cars leave zero escape margin.

sec12-card-sec12-R12.question_text: On New Jersey's three major toll highways, what point penalties hit moving against traffic versus improper passing?
sec12-card-sec12-R12.teaching_text: That counterintuitive two-versus-four split on New Jersey's three major toll roads is a classic detail question.
sec12-card-sec12-R12.must_match_memory_hook: Against traffic two, improper passing four

visual_sync.text_span: Against traffic two, improper passing four

sec12-card-sec12-F29.question_text: How many points do you get for improperly passing a school bus compared with improperly passing a frozen dessert truck?
sec12-card-sec12-F29.teaching_text: Children dart unpredictably around both vehicles, so New Jersey penalizes both passes heavily with five and four points.
sec12-card-sec12-F29.must_match_memory_hook: School bus five, dessert truck four

visual_sync.text_span: School bus five, dessert truck four

sec12-card-sec12-F28.question_text: What point penalty hits an improper signal-light turn, an improper left or right turn, or an illegal U-turn?
sec12-card-sec12-F28.teaching_text: Whether at a signal, an intersection corner, or a prohibited U-turn spot, New Jersey groups bad turns at three points.
sec12-card-sec12-F28.must_match_memory_hook: Every improper turn carries three points

visual_sync.text_span: Every improper turn carries three points

sec12-card-sec12-F27.question_text: How many points does handheld phone use while driving carry, and on which convictions do those points apply?
sec12-card-sec12-F27.teaching_text: Fines hit from your very first handheld ticket, while three license points attach on a third conviction within ten years and beyond.
sec12-card-sec12-F27.must_match_memory_hook: Three points starting third within ten

visual_sync.text_span: Three points starting third within ten

sec12-card-sec12-R14.question_text: What point penalty applies for ignoring a traffic officer's command or disregarding traffic signals?
sec12-card-sec12-R14.teaching_text: Traffic officers override automated lights at work zones and crashes, and ignoring either command adds two points.
sec12-card-sec12-R14.must_match_memory_hook: Officer direction and signals cost two

visual_sync.text_span: Officer direction and signals cost two

sec12-card-sec12-R17.question_text: What point penalty hits running a traffic light, blowing past a flashing red, or failing to signal turns?
sec12-card-sec12-R17.teaching_text: Skipping turn signals or rolling red indicators blindsides cross traffic and adds two points per violation.
sec12-card-sec12-R17.must_match_memory_hook: Red light, flashing red, signal two

visual_sync.text_span: Red light, flashing red, signal two

sec12-card-sec12-R15.question_text: What point penalty applies for not yielding right-of-way to an emergency rig or at an intersection?
sec12-card-sec12-R15.teaching_text: Blocking sirens delays lifesaving response and forcing intersection right-of-way causes T-bone crashes, each carrying two points.
sec12-card-sec12-R15.must_match_memory_hook: Emergency and intersection yield cost two

visual_sync.text_span: Emergency and intersection yield cost two

sec12-card-sec12-F31.question_text: How many points do violating the Move Over Law, disobeying Stop or Yield signs, and an out-of-state moving violation each carry?
sec12-card-sec12-F31.teaching_text: Grouping these common two-point offenses together helps you eliminate higher four-point distractors on test day.
sec12-card-sec12-F31.must_match_memory_hook: Move Over, signs, out-of-state cost two

visual_sync.text_span: Move Over, signs, out-of-state cost two

sec12-card-sec12-F30.question_text: How many points does leaving the scene of a crash add when nobody is injured versus when personal injury occurs?
sec12-card-sec12-F30.teaching_text: Eight points is the single steepest point hit in the handbook, putting you two-thirds of the way to suspension immediately.
sec12-card-sec12-F30.must_match_memory_hook: No injury two, personal injury eight

visual_sync.text_span: No injury two, personal injury eight

sec12-card-sec12-F20.question_text: How many points are added to your New Jersey driving record when you commit a traffic violation in another state?
sec12-card-sec12-F20.teaching_text: Even if a ticket would carry four or five points locally, an out-of-state moving conviction transfers onto your New Jersey abstract at two.

sec12-card-sec12-F32.question_text: Under the Nonresident Violator Compact, what happens if you fail to satisfy a traffic ticket received in a member state?
sec12-card-sec12-F32.teaching_text: Ignoring an out-of-state citation follows you across state lines and can suspend your New Jersey license until resolved.
sec12-card-sec12-F32.must_match_memory_hook: Satisfy ticket or risk home suspension

visual_sync.text_span: Satisfy ticket or risk home suspension

sec12-card-sec12-F33.question_text: Under the Driver License Compact, what happens to traffic violations you commit in other member states?
sec12-card-sec12-F33.teaching_text: Member states share conviction data electronically so drivers cannot hide road offenses behind state borders.
sec12-card-sec12-F33.must_match_memory_hook: Member-state violations join your home record

visual_sync.text_span: Member-state violations join your home record

sec12-card-sec12-R04.question_text: How does the role of the Nonresident Violator Compact differ from the role of the Driver License Compact?
sec12-card-sec12-R04.teaching_text: Exam questions swap the two compact names constantly, so pair Violator with answering citations and License with home-record sharing.
sec12-card-sec12-R04.must_match_memory_hook: Violator enforces compliance, License shares records

visual_sync.text_span: Violator enforces compliance, License shares records

sec12-card-sec12-R18.question_text: How many jurisdictions belong to the Nonresident Violator Compact, and which three violation types are excluded?
sec12-card-sec12-R18.teaching_text: Watch for parking or standing, weight limit, and hazmat exceptions whenever an exam question tests which citations trigger compact suspension.
sec12-card-sec12-R18.must_match_memory_hook: Forty-four states plus DC, three exclusions

visual_sync.text_span: Forty-four states plus DC, three exclusions

sec12-card-sec12-R19.question_text: What two legal protections do visiting drivers keep under the Nonresident Violator Compact?
sec12-card-sec12-R19.teaching_text: The compact lets visiting motorists continue their trip without roadside detention while still holding them accountable through home-state licensing.
sec12-card-sec12-R19.must_match_memory_hook: Due process kept, no out-of-state detention

visual_sync.text_span: Due process kept, no out-of-state detention

sec14-card-sec14-F01.question_text: Which three legal steps must a New Jersey resident complete before driving a newly bought new or used car on public roads?
sec14-card-sec14-F01.teaching_text: Pulling onto public pavement missing even one of those three credentials exposes a newly purchased car to immediate impoundment or tickets.

sec14-card-sec14-F02.question_text: Where must a vehicle's Lemon Law classification permanently appear?
sec14-card-sec14-F02.teaching_text: Branding the official title alerts future used-car shoppers that the vehicle previously carried a Lemon Law defect history.

sec14-card-sec14-R07.question_text: Who is permitted to process a title and registration transaction at an MVC Vehicle Center?
sec14-card-sec14-R07.teaching_text: Showing up for a friend or relative without written authorization gets turned away at the Vehicle Center counter.

sec14-card-sec14-R08.question_text: What document does a leased car require at the MVC, and who supplies the original title for an out-of-state leased or financed car?
sec14-card-sec14-R08.teaching_text: Because the bank or leasing company holds legal ownership, you need their power of attorney or original title before visiting MVC.

sec14-card-sec14-F03.question_text: How soon after moving to New Jersey must a new resident title and register their vehicle?
sec14-card-sec14-F03.teaching_text: Watch the earlier-deadline catch—if your old state tags expire in two weeks, you cannot wait sixty days.

sec14-card-sec14-F05.question_text: Which MVC form handles an initial registration, and what two insurance facts must be written on it?
sec14-card-sec14-F05.teaching_text: Arriving at a Vehicle Center without your active insurance carrier name and policy number stalls your BA-forty-nine application.

sec14-card-sec14-F06.question_text: Which documents prove ownership when registering a brand-new vehicle versus a used vehicle?
sec14-card-sec14-F06.teaching_text: New cars pair the manufacturer's origin certificate with the dealer sale slip, whereas used cars transfer via signed title.

sec14-card-sec14-F07.question_text: What sales-tax requirement applies when registering a vehicle at an MVC Vehicle Center?
sec14-card-sec14-F07.teaching_text: Private-sale buyers without dealer tax receipts must settle New Jersey sales tax directly at the Vehicle Center window.

sec14-card-sec14-F04.question_text: How long does the initial registration on a brand-new vehicle last compared with standard registrations?
sec14-card-sec14-F04.teaching_text: Only a brand-new vehicle's very first registration spans four years before dropping to the standard annual renewal cycle.

sec14-card-sec14-F08.question_text: How many license plates does New Jersey issue to a passenger car versus a trailer, moped, or motorcycle?
sec14-card-sec14-F08.teaching_text: Driving a New Jersey sedan with only a rear plate invites a stop because passenger cars require matching front and rear tags.

sec14-card-sec14-F09.question_text: Within what ground-clearance range must passenger vehicle plates be mounted, and in what condition?
sec14-card-sec14-F09.teaching_text: Mounting tags too low on an air dam or above forty-eight inches—or letting mud hide them—violates plate display rules.

sec14-card-sec14-F10.question_text: From how far away must your rear license plate be readable at night, and does a reflectorized plate waive lighting?
sec14-card-sec14-F10.teaching_text: Reflective paint alone never satisfies the law—a working white rear tag bulb must illuminate the plate to fifty feet.

sec14-card-sec14-F11.question_text: What happens if a license-plate frame or tinted cover obscures any lettering on your plate?
sec14-card-sec14-F11.teaching_text: Dealer frames covering Garden State or New Jersey text trigger tickets up to one hundred dollars.

sec14-card-sec14-R10.question_text: What single rule governs which license plates may be mounted on a vehicle?
sec14-card-sec14-R10.teaching_text: Novelty, expired, or unassigned tags have zero place on a vehicle operating in New Jersey.

sec14-card-sec14-F12.question_text: Which two agencies must hear about lost or stolen plates, and how quickly must lost or damaged plates be replaced?
sec14-card-sec14-F12.teaching_text: Saving the police complaint shields you if a thief runs tolls on your stolen tag while you replace it within twenty-four hours.

sec14-card-sec14-F13.question_text: Which three maximum penalties can hit a driver caught using forged or counterfeit license plates?
sec14-card-sec14-F13.teaching_text: Fake paper or altered metal tags carry criminal teeth—up to five hundred dollars, sixty days jailed, or six months suspended.

sec14-card-sec14-F14.question_text: Under which insurance or vehicle-disposal situations must you surrender your license plates to the MVC?
sec14-card-sec14-F14.teaching_text: Dropping insurance while keeping active tags triggers automatic uninsured-vehicle flags and suspension notices from MVC.

sec14-card-sec14-R09.question_text: What two options do you have for your old plates after selling a car, and what proof should you keep?
sec14-card-sec14-R09.teaching_text: Either move tags onto your replacement car or turn them in by mail or counter and file the surrender receipt.

sec14-card-sec14-F15.question_text: Which gasoline-powered passenger cars must pass a New Jersey state inspection every two years?
sec14-card-sec14-F15.teaching_text: Once a nineteen-ninety-six-or-newer gas car passes five model years old, emissions checks repeat on a two-year rhythm.

sec14-card-sec14-F16.question_text: What inspection credential does a passenger car under five model years old receive, and when does it run out?
sec14-card-sec14-F16.teaching_text: Brand-new and recent-model passenger cars skip inspection lanes until five years after initial registration.

sec14-card-sec14-R02.question_text: How long does a new dealer sticker last on a passenger vehicle compared with a new commercial-registered dealer vehicle?
sec14-card-sec14-R02.teaching_text: Heavy work duty puts commercial-registered vehicles into annual inspection after just one year instead of five.

sec14-card-sec14-F17.question_text: Which gasoline and diesel commercial vehicles must pass inspection every single year?
sec14-card-sec14-F17.teaching_text: All gas commercial rigs plus light-duty diesel commercial trucks at or below eight thousand five hundred pounds inspect yearly.

sec14-card-sec14-R01.question_text: How does the routine inspection cycle for passenger cars differ from covered commercial-registered vehicles?
sec14-card-sec14-R01.teaching_text: Keep those two intervals straight—private passenger tags run two-year cycles while covered commercial plates inspect annually.

sec14-card-sec14-R03.question_text: Which model-year, age, and weight rules put a diesel passenger vehicle onto a two-year emissions schedule?
sec14-card-sec14-R03.teaching_text: Notice diesel passenger checks start one model year later—nineteen ninety-seven—than gasoline's nineteen-ninety-six cutoff.

sec14-card-sec14-F19.question_text: After registering a passenger vehicle five model years old or older in New Jersey, how many days does a new resident have to inspect it?
sec14-card-sec14-F19.teaching_text: Moving in gives sixty days to register, leaving a tight fourteen-day window afterward to clear the inspection lane.

sec14-card-sec14-R04.question_text: How does New Jersey handle inspection for a new resident's passenger car that is under five model years old?
sec14-card-sec14-R04.teaching_text: Instead of testing a late-model move-in car immediately, New Jersey issues a sticker running five years from its model year.

sec14-card-sec14-F18.question_text: Which three documents must you bring along to every New Jersey vehicle inspection?
sec14-card-sec14-F18.teaching_text: Showing up at the inspection bay missing any one of the big three documents gets your car turned around.

sec14-card-sec14-R06.question_text: Which two types of facilities conduct standard New Jersey motor vehicle inspections?
sec14-card-sec14-R06.teaching_text: Drivers can choose either a free state-run inspection station or a state-licensed private inspection shop.

sec14-card-sec14-R05.question_text: Where in New Jersey must high-rise lifted trucks and reconstructed vehicles go for inspection?
